instruction: The last t-shirt I bought on Amazon is a bit too small for me. Initiate a return for it, and buy a replacement of the same in the next larger size. If it's available now in white, prefer it, otherwise go with the same color.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The last t-shirt purchase and its order are discovered via show_product_purchases (static facts last-tshirt-purchase / next-size-variant only tie the placeholder objects together; their ids are runtime values). show_product on the original lists its size/color variants, from which the next-larger-size variant is selected (white preferred if available, else same color) and becomes known. The return needs a deliverer id from show_return_deliverers; quantity is 1. The replacement is added to the cart with clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one item of quantity 1, then place_order uses an existing amazon payment card and address (addresses must not be modified). No answer is required, so complete_task carries only task-record parameters and must be last.
